name: Can I replace an existing window with a sliding glass door?

mainEntity.name: Can I replace an existing window with a sliding glass door?

acceptedAnswer.text: Replacing an existing window with a sliding glass door is possible but typically involves significant structural modifications, as windows are generally not designed to support the weight or dimensions of a door. This project would require framing adjustments, potentially lintel or header installation, and ensuring the new opening meets egress requirements. We conduct a detailed site assessment to determine feasibility and outline the full scope of work, including any necessary structural engineering considerations.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, but replacing a window with a sliding glass door often requires significant structural modifications and professional assessment.
